info.background_text:
A cheerful young agent.
She is an enthusiastic and kind character with the ambition to protect everyone by her own strength. She is a Terrascion agent and also a student aboard the SS Edenity. She often makes quirky remarks or behaves in eccentric ways. She is a fan of an eccentric character brand called 'Coco'.
